jobs.title: Annuity Product Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
You will serve as a technical subject matter expert on the Annuity Product Management and Development Team and provide system expertise in all aspects of the design, development, maintenance, launch, and sale of Guardian’s individual annuities while working with large and diverse cross-functional teams and outside business partners and vendors.

Requirements:

- Minimum requirements : - Expert-level knowledge of annuity product design, administration systems, and product configurations.
- Education:  - BA/BS+ or equivalent work experience
- Strong writing and proofreading skills

- Experience: 10+ years in financial services, 5+ years working with policy administration systems
- Advanced skill level in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

- Preferred requirements: - Proven experience leading the implementation of new product launches and enhancements.

Responsibilities:

New Product Development and Enhancements

- Lead the development of detailed specifications for new annuity products and enhancements, driving consensus among cross-functional stakeholders on product features, business rules, and system functionality while managing the development lifecycle and communicating requirements, updates, and changes.
- Evaluate new product concepts for operational and technical feasibility.
- Review and approve contract, rider, and prospectus language for consistency with product specifications.
- Develop and maintain illustration systems.
- Problem resolution and exception request reviews.

Testing Oversight and Product System Specialist (Transcend, ALIP)

- Review and approve test cases developed by the ESQA and IT teams, ensuring validation of new product features, calculations, business rules, contract values, workflows, and system functionality.
- Identify testing gaps, request additional test scenarios as needed, communicate defects and approve testing results upon successful validation of product requirements.
- Act as a liaison between the Product and Technology teams, leveraging deep expertise in annuity products and Transcend administration to translate business requirements into ALIP configuration and design.

Client Communications

- Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of client-facing (regulatory required) communications, including transaction confirmations, quarterly statements, annual statements, and other required disclosures.
- Partner with IT (ECM), Operations, Compliance, and Legal teams to define business requirements, and ensure accurate representation of product features, values, calculations, and regulatory content across all client and financial rep platforms (Client portal, Client Manager).

Annuity Rate Management and Implementation

- Participate in the weekly deployment of annuity (FIA, RILA, SPIA, DIA, and SPDA) product new business and renewal rates across multiple administration and illustration systems.
- Update spreadsheets for In-Force rates using rate data provided by Investments/Actuarial.

Location
- While we are open to fully remote candidates in this position, candidates who are located within a commutable distance to a Guardian Life hub-office will be expected to be in-person 3 days per week.

$86,210.00 - $141,635.00

The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. jobs.title: Head of Product Strategy & Platform Innovation
jobs.description:
The Head of Product Strategy & Platform Innovation is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic evolution, differentiation, and commercial success of our open‑architecture wealth management product platform. This individual wakes up every day thinking about what’s next —how product, partners, packaging, and go‑to‑market strategy come together to create a compelling, modern, and advisor‑centric platform across fee‑based advisory, annuities, and alternatives. We do not manufacture products. Our competitive advantage comes from curation, partnership, design, positioning, and delivery . This role exists to ensure our platform is not merely comprehensive—but distinctive, relevant, and growth‑oriented . The role works horizontally across the organization —marketing, sales, business development, training, product management—and externally with asset managers, insurance carriers, TAMPs, and portfolio managers . Success requires influence without direct ownership, entrepreneurial energy, and a strong commercial mindset.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Innovation
- Own the forward‑looking product strategy across advisory, annuities, and alternatives within an open‑architecture ecosystem.

- Identify gaps, white spaces, and emerging opportunities driven by advisor needs, client behavior, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

- Design differentiated product constructs, solutions, and portfolios by creatively leveraging third‑party partners rather than manufacturing products.

- Translate industry trends (e.g., retirement income, tax efficiency, private markets, managed solutions, model portfolios) into actionable platform initiatives.

Platform Differentiation & Go‑to‑Market
- Develop clear go‑to‑market strategies for platform capabilities, including positioning, messaging, and advisor value propositions.

- Partner closely with Marketing to ensure product stories are simple, compelling, and commercially effective .

- Work with Sales and Business Development to align product strategy with advisor adoption, growth objectives, and field readiness .

- Drive clarity around why advisors should use specific solutions—not just what is available.

Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Management
- Serve as a senior point of engagement with asset managers, insurance carriers, TAMPs, and product sponsors .

- Evaluate, onboard, and rationalize partners with a focus on quality, differentiation, economics, and strategic fit .

- Co‑create solutions with partners where appropriate, including custom portfolios, white‑labeled offerings, or exclusive access strategies .

- Maintain a strong commercial lens on platform economics, scalability, and advisor impact.

Cross‑Functional Leadership & Influence
- Act as a strategic connector across Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Training, and Business Development.

- Provide strategic direction while leveraging existing execution teams for implementation.

- Influence priorities and outcomes without direct people ownership , using clarity, credibility, and collaboration.

- Partner with Training and Sales Enablement to ensure advisors understand not just products—but how to use them in holistic planning conversations .

What Success Looks Like
- Advisors view the platform as thoughtful, differentiated, and easy to position with clients .

- Product initiatives are clearly linked to advisor adoption, client outcomes, and revenue growth .

- Partners see the firm as a strategic collaborator , not just a distributor.

- The platform evolves proactively— not reactively —to market and advisor needs.

Qualifications & Experience
- 10+ years of experience in wealth management, asset management, insurance, or fintech, with exposure to RIA and broker‑dealer environments .

- Deep knowledge of fee‑based advisory, annuities, alternatives, and managed solutions .

- Demonstrated ability to build or evolve open‑architecture platforms without manufacturing products.

- Strong commercial and go‑to‑market orientation —understands how strategy translates into advisor behavior.

- Proven success working cross‑functionally and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to balance vision with practical execution .

- Comfortable operating with ambiguity and turning ideas into scalable initiatives.

Why This Role Matters
- This role ensures our product platform moves from “robust but pedestrian” to strategically curated, commercially sharp, and advisor‑obsessed —without disrupting what already works operationally.

- It complements strong execution with vision, innovation, and market leadership .

jobs.description:
Our 2027 Summer Internship Program is a paid 10-week learning experience where you will be immersed in the daily environment of a thriving global financial services company. You will gain invaluable industry and organizational knowledge through daily business interactions and job assignments, in addition to engaging in projects that directly affect our business, interact with senior leaders in conversational settings, and network with employees and interns across our offices. This 10-week internship provides you with realistic experiences and information of what it is like to work at Guardian.

Internship Dates:
The internship program will run from Thursday, May 27, 2027- Friday, August 6, 2027 .

We review applications on a rolling basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as you are ready. The application window will close on Friday, November 13th, 2026, at 11:59PM ET or when role(s) have been filled, whichever comes first.

You are:
A current junior (graduation date of May 2028) who is fueled by collaboration, able to listen and make quick decisions and thrive in a goal-oriented environment.

Location (Housing is not provided):
- Boston, MA

You have:
Required Qualifications
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills

- Analytical approach to problem-solving and comfort working with data in Excel and PowerPoint

- Ability to manage priorities, learn quickly, and turn insights into clear recommendations

Preferred Qualifications
- Interest in product management, employee benefits, absence management, or financial services

- Comfort using data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

- Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate findings clearly

You will:
- Analyze absence, product KPI’s, and customer data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

- Research competitor, client, and regulatory trends across FMLA, ADA, and State Leave programs

- Support Absence Roadmap, ACE Digital Experience, reporting, and go-to-market deliverables

- Have the opportunity to work and learn from supportive leaders, mentors, and team members across the organization who will help coach you as you develop your professional career

- Learn about Guardian’s purpose, values, how we work, and our suite of product and service offerings

- Build a network of colleagues and have a sense of community with other interns and other parts of the business

- Think broadly and ask questions about data, facts, and other information

We offer:
- Meaningful and challenging work opportunities to accelerate innovation in a secure and compliant way

- Dynamic, modern work environments that promote collaboration and creativity to develop and empower talent

- Colleague Engagement Communities that create inclusive spaces where you can feel valued and connected

- Social responsibility in all aspects of our work- we volunteer within our local communities, create educational alliances with colleges, drive a variety of initiatives in sustainability

Eligibility:
- Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. without company sponsorship, now or in the future, for employment-based work authorization. F-1 visa holders with Optional Practical Training (OPT) who will require H-1B status, TNs, or current H-1B visa holders will not be considered. H1-B and green card sponsorship are not available for this position.

- You must be available for the full program dates of the internship program.

If you have any questions regarding the application process, please feel free to email Guardian_Campus@glic.com .

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Wealth Management
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Owner, Wealth Management, you will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and driving product capabilities that support the Wealth Management business and enable a more intuitive, efficient, and valuable experience. This role serves as a critical connection point between business strategy, field/advisor needs, operational processes, technology delivery, data capabilities, and third-party platform partners.

This role requires strong product ownership discipline, deep collaboration skills, and the ability to balance competing stakeholder needs while helping drive alignment, priorities, decisions, and execution.

You will
- Translate product vision and business strategy into a prioritized backlog, clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities aligned to business, customer, and enterprise goals.

- Partner with Product Managers, Technology Leads, business stakeholders, operations, data, compliance, and third-party providers to deliver Wealth Management capabilities that create business value and improve user experience.

- Build deep understanding of Wealth Management workflows, products, services, processes, data needs, advisor experience gaps, operational challenges, and technology dependencies to shape product decisions and improvement opportunities.

- Define, prioritize, sequence, and refine enhancements, integrations, process improvements and actionable backlog items with the Product Manager and Technology Lead.

- Collaborate with technology, vendor, data, analytics, and AI partners to support reporting needs, governance expectations, and data/AI standards into product solutions.

- Use process analysis, root cause analysis, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities across advisor, client, operations, and business user experiences.

- Support release readiness, communications, training needs, adoption planning, feedback loops, OKR tracking, milestone reporting, and stakeholder updates to maintain delivery momentum and business alignment.

Required Experience:
- A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in product management, product ownership, business transformation, technology delivery, or a related field.

- Experience working in or supporting the wealth management industry

- Familiarity with wealth management platforms, financial planning platforms, portfolio management tools, or other wealth management technology solutions.

- Knowledge of wealth management products, advisor/client workflows, operations, and business processes,

- Proven experience translating business needs, customer research, stakeholder feedback, and strategic priorities into roadmaps, requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.

- Experience working with cross-functional teams with the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders while helping drive toward clear priorities, informed decisions, and timely execution.

- Strong product ownership skills, including backlog management, prioritization, acceptance criteria development, dependency management, and release readiness.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex concepts to both business and technical audiences.

Preferred Experience
- Understanding of RIAs or broker-dealer operations, and investment products.

- Understanding of the advisor experience, including how advisors engage with clients, manage relationships, complete business processes, access data, and use technology to support growth and service.

$99,150.00 - $162,885.00
